title: StreamersTip Tippy Onboarding Contract v1
description: Shared vocabulary for website + Flutter Tippy-first onboarding. Slim 7 questions, guided creator profile, guest session, funnel stages, analytics.

canonicalCopy.welcome: Hi there! I'm Tippy. Welcome to StreamersTip!
canonicalCopy.questionsIntro: I have seven quick questions so I can personalize your creator workspace and help you grow.
canonicalCopy.preSignup: Perfect — I've started building your creator profile. Create your free account so I can save your answers and personalize StreamersTip for you.
canonicalCopy.notificationsExplain: I can remind you when it's time to create content, celebrate your milestones, and let you know when your posts perform well.
canonicalCopy.notificationsDeclined: No problem! You can always enable reminders later.
canonicalCopy.trialIntro: Based on what you've shared... I've already started building your creator workspace. I'd love to unlock everything for your first 7 days.
canonicalCopy.verifyEmail: One last step. Check your email so I know it's really you.
canonicalCopy.accountSecured: Great! Your account is secure. Now let's build the creator profile people will see on StreamersTip.
canonicalCopy.avatarPrompt: Let's add a profile picture so creators can recognize you.
canonicalCopy.usernamePrompt: Now choose your unique @username. People will use this to find and mention you.
canonicalCopy.bioPrompt: Tell creators what you make and what you're working toward.
canonicalCopy.categoriesPrompt: Which content areas best describe you?
canonicalCopy.profileReviewPrompt: Here's how your creator profile will appear. You can change any of this later.
canonicalCopy.findFriends: Want to see creators you already know? I can check your contacts and recommend people to follow.
canonicalCopy.success: Your creator profile is ready! I've also used your answers to personalize StreamersTip around your goals.
canonicalCopy.landingChoice: Great! Where would you like to start?

questions.prompt: What kind of creator are you?
questions.tippySpeech: First — how do you usually show up as a creator?
questions.why: So I can tailor coaching and templates to your creator style.

questions.prompt: Which platforms do you focus on most?
questions.tippySpeech: Where do you publish most right now? (No need to connect accounts yet.)
questions.why: So recommendations and planners match your platforms.

questions.prompt: How would you describe your niche?
questions.tippySpeech: In one short line — what's your niche?
questions.why: So Tippy can suggest ideas that fit your world.
questions.placeholder: e.g. Competitive FPS with chill vibes

questions.prompt: How experienced are you as a creator?
questions.tippySpeech: How experienced do you feel as a creator today?
questions.why: So coaching depth matches where you are now.

questions.prompt: What are your main creator goals right now?
questions.tippySpeech: What do you want help with most?
questions.why: So your dashboard and Tippy focus on the right outcomes.

questions.prompt: How often do you usually post?
questions.tippySpeech: How often are you posting or streaming right now?
questions.why: So reminders and plans match your real rhythm.

questions.prompt: Which content formats do you create most?
questions.tippySpeech: What formats do you create most?
questions.why: So templates and ideas match how you publish.

guestSessionShape.profileDraft: avatar, displayName, username, bio, platforms, categories
